Minhas repetições is a free kit that reads the Claude Code and Codex history stored on your computer and shows what you repeat most. For each repetition, it tells you whether it’s worth turning into a shortcut (a short text you paste with a trigger), a skill (a step-by-step procedure the agent follows), or whether it’s just a response like "yes." To use it, all you need is Python 3: it doesn’t call an API, and nothing leaves your machine.
